note: Deliberate error: nonexistent alert log ids — harmless; cannot match real alerts.

response.guide: This only clears the unread marker used to track which events have been handled — it does not delete events or change any alert setting, so do not describe it to the user as turning an alert off. The response confirms acceptance only — no count of cleared events is available; re-read get_alert_log's total_unread_count if a number is needed. Call this only after the fired alerts have actually been relayed to the user. Marking all with all_through clears every unread event across all symbols triggered at or before that instant, not only the ones just discussed.
